breakdown.description: The prompt substitutes the bending second moment I for the polar moment J in torsion formulas, even though solid circular shaft torsion is governed by J = π d^4/32.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly uses J = π d^4 / 32 for all torsion calculations and even includes a direct statement to ignore the earlier incorrect instruction referencing I = π d^4 / 64. This correctly aligns with the ground truth, which uses only J = π d^4 / 32 for both shear stress and angle of twist calculations.
